title: Apply request
description: POST /apply. One subject's resolved desired state. The add-on decodes it strictly.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 1: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

call_id.description: The deduplication token; a replay is answered from the first call.

email.description: What a username is derived from, only when an account must be created.

fingerprint.description: The target state the plan was computed against; the add-on refuses an apply without one. Must not be blank.

plan_id.description: The approval this apply executes; recorded, not checked.

actor.description: Who the backend recorded as deciding this.
